title: The moon is always late (Karwa Chauth eve)
caption:
The moon is always late on Karwa Chauth. So we matched a necklace to it.

The Serpentine Whisper Chain: one cushion-cut cubic zirconia, about 10 mm, on a smooth 2 mm snake chain, 40 cm with a 5 cm extender. ₹1,299.

It usually reaches you in 3 to 5 working days, so it arrives after the moon. Only fair: the moon keeps everyone waiting too.

[ serpentine whisper chain · 18k gold tone plated · here after the moon ]
alt_text: A deep wine-plum night tile. A full moon rises from behind a drawn steel Karwa Chauth sieve with a gold beaded border and a red inner ring: its right side shows clear of the rim, and where the sieve covers it the moon shows only as light through the tiny holes. Cream capitals read: The moon is always late. Below, in blush italics: so we matched a necklace to it. At the bottom, a gold-tone snake chain laid at a slight slant with one clear cushion-cut stone in a soft round glow, like a small moon, tied by a thin thread to an ivory tag reading Shade N° 02, matched to the moon, one cushion stone, about 10 mm. Small type at the top reads: The Match, N° 02, Karwa Chauth.
deviations: Caption, paragraph 3: the spec's 'Order tonight and it arrives a few days after the moon.' is an order-by line (brand-bible never-list #11; no courier cut-off is confirmed) and reads as soft urgency. Now 'It usually reaches you in 3 to 5 working days, so it arrives after the moon. Only fair: the moon keeps everyone waiting too.' 'Usually' keeps it true: the bible rates 3-5 working days SAFE-ish (serviceability.ts; llms.txt says 3-7) and this is festive courier season. The second sentence no longer repeats 'always late', already in the headline and caption line 1. Posted Wed 28 Oct, Karwa Chauth Thu 29 Oct, so 'after the moon' holds for any order from the post. The bracket line is unchanged.

Chalni plate opaque: the spec's #5B4A5E 'at 90%' let the moon's disc ghost through the solid steel as a pale crescent about 14 levels lighter ((106,90,106) against (92,72,92)), so the sieve read as tinted glass. The plate is now #5B4A5E at 100%; the moon shows only through the holes, which trace its edge on their own ('its light pricking through the sieve's holes').

Chalni shadow arc moved inside: the spec's 2px #2A1B26 arc 'lower-right' sat on the rim's outer edge exactly where the rim crosses the moon and drew a near-black keyline on the cream (about x600-670, y540-660). It is now on the lip where plate meets rim, r220.5, 1.5px, stroke-opacity .5, over 185-275deg (upper-left: a raised rim lit from the upper-left shades the plate on that side). It ends at canvas (449,210), well clear of the moon (r180 about (600,400)). Highlight arc 3px #D9D3DC, 175-275deg, r235 (rim outer half); rim band r220-240; 499 d9 holes on the 18 / 15.6px hex grid, 7px clear of the rim.

Rim arcs fade at their ends (art-director fix, pass 3): the highlight and lip-shadow arcs ended in hard round caps; at 1x the highlight read as a clip-art stroke and at 2x the lip shadow left a visible step where it stopped. Colours, widths, radii and angles are unchanged; each now strokes with a userSpaceOnUse linearGradient from its start point to its end point, opacity 0 / 1 / 1 / 0 at 0 / 20 / 80 / 100% (about 23deg in from each end of the highlight, 20deg of the lip shadow), no caps.

Hero (grid-director fix, 26 Oct): the Serpentine Whisper Chain is 600 wide (was 500; native 960, so 62.5%), centre (390,1165), turned 10deg clockwise (was 15). At 500 the stone, the 'little moon', was about 27px on a phone. The chain's hull spans x106-687, y944-1350 (computed from the matte hull, confirmed on the render: ink y944.5-1349.5), inside the x80-730 / y915-1390 box the fix set; the stone sits at about (185,1291) and the 4:5 crop keeps 45px under the pendant. History: the spec placed it straight at (370,1195); pass 3 had it at 500 wide, (370,1207), 15deg.

Pendant glow: the moon's treatment in small, a ROUND cream glow centred on the stone and drawn behind the cut-out, #F6EFE6 at 22%, now 180x180 (was 150x150, enlarged with the chain), blur 22, at (185,1291) (the stone's new centre; the fix's 'about (205,1285)' measured to (185,1291) on the matte: native stone centre ~(192,612)). Still no dark contact shadow. History: the spec's 10% ellipse could not be seen, pass 2's 30% ellipse read as a mauve-grey pool.

Thread anchor (682.7,1160.8): the chain loop's right edge after the resize (the fix's 'about (688,1150)', the hull's rightmost point being (687.2,1160.3)); it maps to matte native (940,268), alpha 255, 5px inside the edge, so the thread ends on solid chain. Path M904 1073 Q793.35 1190.8 682.7 1160.8 (the system's default control point).

Tag (grid-director fix 1, 26 Oct): the chip is now the system's inset window (208x48 at (16,16), framed by paper), so SHADE N° 02's wine-plum chip, the ground's own colour, no longer vanishes into the ground and the tag keeps the nine-tag silhouette. The page-level 'paper core' script that drew a 1.5px ivory edge round the chip is deleted (here and in _work/build.py). Size, position, angle, chip colour and text are the spec's.

Moon, chalni and type re-proportioned (grid-director fix, 26 Oct) so the chain could grow: chalni drawn on its d480 viewBox but shown at d403 centred (430,390) (svg left 228, top 188); moon d302 centred (573,365) (was d360 at (600,400)); its glow d470 (was d560); headline baselines b700 / b800 (were b790 / b890), turn b868 (was b958). Measured ink: headline y631-799.5, turn 830.5-867.5 (31px under the headline), chain from y944.5 (77px under the turn; the fix asked at least 40).

Optical centring: 'ALWAYS LATE.' moves 8px right so its full stop hangs and its letters centre under 'THE MOON IS' (measured ink centres 537 / 539); the turn moves 3px right for the same reason. Measured baselines 789.2 / 889.2 / 957.1 for b790 / b890 / b958.

ECD pass (26 Oct), in _work/build.py. The chalni's rim is decorated so it reads as a Karwa Chauth chalni, not an eclipse or Venn icon: after the steel rim (r230, #9C93A3, 20) a gota band (r229, #C99A4C, 12), gota beads (r229, #E7C27A, 5, round caps, dash 0.1/14.3) and a red inner ring (r219, #8E1B2B, 5); perforations and moon unchanged. The Serpentine Whisper Chain is 680 wide (native 960; was 600), centre (380,1178), 10deg: hull x58-717, y928-1387 (x<740; ~46px under the turn's descenders; inside the 4:5 crop). Stone glow at (148,1321) and thread to (711.7,1173.2), both the same matte points as before (native (192,612) and (940,268), opaque). The stone is ~113px. Alt text 1 updated; caption unchanged.

Thread re-anchored (grid-director SF4, 26 Oct): the thread now ends on solid chain on the outer loop's upper-right arc at (642,1047), matte native (812,110), alpha 255, 4.2px inside the chain (the fix's 'about (640,1050)'); path M904 1073 Q773 1103 642 1047 (the system's default control point). The old anchor, the loop's rightmost point (711.7,1173.2), left 61px of thread outside the tag, so at grid size the tag read as dropped beside the chain; now 146px (check.cjs). It reaches the hole from the upper left like the other covers and runs ~80px above the chain's right arc at x700; its last ~39px lie along the arc's upper edge before it ends, which reads as tied at 2x. Chain size and position unchanged (680 wide, centre (380,1178), 10deg). SF1 maker's mark (system, 26 Oct): every non-mini tag now carries the flower as a crisp 18x26 blush mark at (111,286) in the tag's lower third, 8px above the inner gold rule, instead of the 62x90 ghost at 12% behind the second name line and the detail (read as a pink smudge at 100%).
checks: Price ₹1,299 = research/roster.json today (25 Oct 2026); stock 20, gift_friendly true, needs_size false, not pre-order. Caption price only; no price, code, percentage or date on the image.

Listing facts checked against the live listing text (src/data/jewellery.ts description): 'Smooth snake chain, 2mm', 'Length: 40cm plus a 5cm extender', 'Cushion cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 10mm', '18k PVD gold tone plated'. Tag detail 'one cushion stone, about 10 mm' and the caption match them. No 'gold' alone, no 'diamond', no water claim on the image or caption.

Copy: no em dashes, exclamation marks, emoji or urgency on the image or in the caption. Caption delivery line is a hedged duration ('usually ... 3 to 5 working days', brand-bible SAFE-ish), not a date or an order-by line; it says plainly the piece arrives after the moon. 'Always late' appears twice (headline, caption line 1), not three times.
Alt text matches the render: the moon's right side shows clear of the rim; only where the sieve covers it does the moon show through the holes. Stone's round glow described.

Pendant glow at 1x (measured on the @2x render, ground (86,52,77)): no grey pool below the pendant (the old ellipse's (97,69,84) is gone; y1350 under the stone reads (86,56,73), the kit's soft drop-shadow); a cream lift around the stone of +8 to +10 levels at 45px from its centre (94,62,83), +3 at 75px, ground by 100px; max deviation 3 levels in x80-320 below y1395, i.e. faded to the ground before the 4:5 crop line. Visible at 391px as a soft halo round the stone.

Vertical rhythm (ink, deviation >40 from the ground (86,52,78), measured on the 26 Oct render): headline 631-799.5, turn 830.5-867.5, chain 944.5-1349.5: 31px headline to turn, 77px turn to chain. Pendant's lowest pixel 1349.5, 45px above the 4:5 crop's bottom edge (1395).

Thread (26 Oct): hole (904,1073) to (642,1047), path M904 1073 Q773 1103 642 1047; the anchor maps to matte native (812,110), alpha 255, 4.2px inside the chain; 146px of thread lie outside the tag polygon (rule >= 120).

Safe areas: all content within y90-1382 (eyebrow cap top 90; chain ink y944.5-1349.5; tag's rotated corner 1382). Top-right x>=907, y<=202 clear (moon glow on the grain only). Nothing but the thread enters x>=740 & y>=1010 (chain right edge x687, stone glow right edge about x275). Tag box unchanged: 753-1027 x 1028-1382, hole (904,1073).

Chalni: plate opaque, so no moon shows through the steel; the moon reads only through the holes and, on its right side, clear of the rim. Rim arcs fade in and out (no caps, no step) at 1x and 2x; both rim/moon crossings (about (556,226) and (618,579)) checked at 2x: no dark line on the moon.
Contrast (WCAG): headline cream on wine plum 9.7; turn blush-mid 7.7; eyebrow kicker 8.1; tag labels warm grey on paper 5.4; tag detail 10.9; tag name 16.4.

Type: Velista 96 ligatures off ('IS' plain), Cormorant italic 50, Jost 500 20 eyebrow, all fonts loaded, no missing images (render.cjs: missingImages [], fontsNotLoaded []); measured baselines 111 / 789.2 / 889.2 / 957.1 for b112 / b790 / b890 / b958; no widows, no clipped glyphs, no overlaps.
Cut-out: serpentine-whisper-chain/00-trim.png native 960x712, shown at 600x445 (62.5%), rotated 10deg, never above native. Crisp edges, true gold, no plaster halo in the extender links or the basket.

Thumb (391x521, 26 Oct): THE MOON IS / ALWAYS LATE. reads; moon, sieve, the larger chain with its stone in the small glow, and the tag with its plum window (now a tag, not a short blank card) all read.
4:5 crop (s01-45.jpg, y45-1395) keeps every element; tag 13px and pendant 45px from the crop's bottom edge.
No Devanagari on this tile (none specified); eyebrow spelling 'KARWA CHAUTH' as specified; Karwa Chauth date not printed (sources split 28/29 Oct).
